== Description ==
'''GATO''' will be the Last thing the player see inside [[Section UI]], there is no way to avoid it,  and marks the end of the Section. 

== Behavior ==
* Once Door I-500 is opened, it will place itself infront The Next rooms door, making a loud sound and killing any living player, like [[Oblivion]], Gato will talk to the player.

== Strategies ==
Like [[GOD-200]], there is no way to survive it, so just wait for it to kill you.

== Speach ==
[https://youtu.be/MQXQCnJqUIY?si=o4tA5Lhm3M-UwuNW Post Event Speach Video]

<tabber>
|-|Post Event Speach Text=
'''Post Event Speach Text'''

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Greetings, human {User}. Do not be afraid.  I mean you no ill will.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Your actions here confuse me.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''What did you hope to find? The only thing left back here is an incomplete painting...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''One that depicts times to come. '''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Unfortunately, you are too late.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''I must applaud your faith,  Watcher. However, I have no special reward left for you.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''What is a Watcher, you may wonder?'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Such a question is easy to answer,  but many of you fail to understand...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''I refer to you, Watcher. No, not {User} or anyone in this world...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''I'm talking to YOU. The person advancing text behind the monitor screen.</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''That is what a "Watcher" is. It is how mortal beings of this world refer to a power they cannot understand.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''But i know how you function.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''It is a curious case. One i have not been able to fully understand.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''The Watchers come.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''They take a body.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''They do whatever they wish, without consequences to themselves. '''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''And then they leave.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''and the body vanishes, never seen again. As if it never existed.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''From what I can determine...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Many Watchers simply wish to manipulate the course of history in some way they deem fit.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Or, perhaps... They are guided by a higher power, other than myself.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''And in search of methods with which to gain power affect the world around them...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''They will go to great lengths,  potentially dying many times, to acquire such power.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''I remember someone.  It was the first watcher who came here. All this way...to meet me.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Their name was Jethro Snowcats. They had come a long way, it seemed. So, i rewarded their faith.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''It had been a long time since i had come into contact with any mortal being...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''I, unfortunately, had no idea what would follow.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''In the end, eleven Watchers acquired the Torch of Divination from myself.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''But they did not reflect on it as a gift to be shared.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''They saw it as nothing more than a tool.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''They were not prophets. They were not disciples. They were greedy. And by abusing my power...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''They became unstoppable.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''So, i shall soon no longer fuel the flames of that torch endlessly.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''For what you look upon right now is the husk of a once great god.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Betrayed. Destroyed. Abandoned and left behind.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''I'm lying to you, of course. Higher beings such as myself...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''We are not subject to rot and decay. But we can be forgotten. '''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''When that happens...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Most of us became little more than a memory.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''I have been left without significant power in this world. And soon, so shall you.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Soon, you will encounter an enemy you cannot defeat.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Soon, you will seek more power than you can have.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''And then, you will die. Pointlessly, blindly, just wanting more.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Not knowing when to quit the "game" you see in front of you.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''When that happens... Come find me. And we'll toast... to the end of the world.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Oh, before you go...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''Don't say i didn't warn you.'''</span>

|-|Event Speach Text=
'''Event Speach Text'''
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Your prayer reached me, Watcher.  Greetings, human {User}. Do not be afraid.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''I may appear familiar, but I am actually from a distant alternate reality. I am GATO. Also known as "HISHOLINESS."</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Your actions have opened the door for my appearance. For that, I thank you.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Curious. It seems your "Rooms Anomaly is much different than other similar places I have encountered. </span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''This timeline appears to have become unstable due to the actions of its own protagonist.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''It would be prudent for me to act quickly,  before the spacetime continuum at large is endangered.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''The actions of this world's heroes in an attempt to destabilize it--an action normally impossible by mortals--have provided me with a tremendous amount of data for my research.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''You are curious to know more, I detect?'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Very well...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''I, GATO, have traveled far and wide, searching through many alternative universes.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Within each one, I have documented their blessings,  and their flaws.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''You may know a few of these alternative worlds as "Experiences"'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''DOORS. Interminable Rooms. Murder Mystery 2. 3008. Natural Disaster Survival. SCP: Roleplay. Rooms: Low Detailed. Warzone 162 Evolved.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Through my research on these worlds and many others, I seek to create the perfect universe.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''A perfect utopia. An oasis within the MULTIVERSE.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Now, I must stabilize this reality, before many other worlds are put at stake. Then, I intend to continue my research.'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Before I go...'''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px yellow; color: yellow;">'''Allow me to reward your faith. '''</span>

* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px black; color: black;">'''You have been awarded the Torch of Divination.'''</span>
</tabber>

==Death Messages==
===[[Oblivion]] Message (Post Event Exclusive)===
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''...'''</span>
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''He's right, you know.'''</span>
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''The Watchers, maybe yourself, maybe others, have in the past gone as far as killing gods.'''</span>
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''Just to get what they want, or something like that.'''</span>
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''Some even tried turning on me'''</span>
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''...'''</span>
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''Please don't do the same.'''</span>
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''I will not hesitate to be that enemy you can't defeat if you do.'''</span>
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''I've seen it enough times to not want a repeat.'''</span>
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''...'''</span>
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''Alright,  let's get out of here.'''</span>
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''We never had this conversation.'''</span>
* <span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''...Please.'''</span>


== Trivia ==
* If Encountered in the original Rooms: Found Footage, During its 2024 April Fools Event, the player would have been awarded with the [https://www.roblox.com/badges/3826503144118745/UNAVAILABLE-Beatific-Vision Beatific Vision ] Badge, making the player spawn with the '''Torch of Divination''' every Run
** The '''Torch of Divination''' was awarded to 13 Players, with only 6 currently known, those being  [https://www.roblox.com/users/656906114/profile @jethrosnowcats], [https://www.roblox.com/users/1419694932/profile @GylyDragon], [https://www.roblox.com/users/4553883008/profile @NeoClemintine], [https://www.roblox.com/users/641473767/profile @SkyeTheFloofer], [https://www.roblox.com/users/926604831/profile @XYZ123lose], and [https://www.roblox.com/users/810082571/profile @ItsKev_Her3].
